page.notes: Column split is unclear: lines are transcribed as printed rows, left and right parts joined. Page numbers in row "Hirmingardis" ("23 [?]") and "ronata" line are doubtful. The "s" long s has been normalised to s and u/v, i/j changed per the rules. Ink is faded and several words at the right edge are partly cut off; "homicida non ordinadus" and "ua-" may be printing errors left as printed. Ornamental mark at the lower left of the page is not text.
